assetCompare.name: Asset compare (p300 codec variants)
assetCompare.description: p300 Phase 1d: the codec variants of phase1Variants.ts against their uncompressed baselines. A tiled rock ground at grazing angles, a MetalRust sphere and the metal toolbox prop, built twice (slots A and B); V switches between them. Debug env: the scene's own "Asset compare" tab picks the variants, shows each texture's file size and VRAM, and runs the collider check.

largeWorld.name: Large ECS test world
largeWorld.description: Stress/soak test scene for large-world patterns (docs/plans/p090_large-ecs-test-world-scene.md). Phase 4: terrain + static overview camera + sun, no dynamics yet.

debugData.name: Large world overview camera
debugData.description: Static wide overview of the terrain (docs/plans/p090_large-ecs-test-world-scene.md §2).

debugData.name: Large world ambient fill
debugData.description: Low-intensity baseline fill so shadowed terrain/foliage isn't pure black — the sun (largeWorldSun) is the dominant light.

debugData.name: Large world sun
debugData.description: Directional shadow-casting sun. Its shadow frustum is intentionally scoped to a bounded play area around the origin, not the whole terrain — sizing it to the full terrain would blur shadow resolution everywhere instead (docs/plans/p090_large-ecs-test-world-scene.md §1.4).

physicsTest.name: Physics API MVP test scene
physicsTest.description: Physics API verification scene: a static ground box, a falling ball, and a falling box, plus impulse-joint and shape-cast worked examples.

debugData.name: Physics test camera
debugData.description: Static camera framing the ground plane and drop zone for the physics API MVP test scene.

debugData.name: Physics test ambient light
debugData.description: Ambient light for the physics API MVP test scene.

debugData.name: Physics test sun
debugData.description: Directional shadow-casting sun for the physics API test scene. Its shadow frustum is sized to the 50x50 ground plane, not larger — oversizing it would degrade shadow resolution everywhere (see largeWorldSun.light.json for the same pattern).

physicsTiers.name: Physics simulation tiers demo
physicsTiers.description: 686 crates in 49 piles, with their simulation tiers following a distance policy around a kinematic plough ball (docs/plans/_DONE_p352_physics-simulation-tiers.md §5). Crates are tinted by tier: orange FULL, blue STATIC, grey DISABLED, ghosted REMOVED. C switches between the overview and chase cameras.

debugData.name: Physics tiers overview camera
debugData.description: Sees the whole 600 x 600 field, so the tier rings can be watched sweeping over the piles. C switches to the chase camera (created in physicsTiers.ts).

debugData.name: Physics tiers ambient fill
debugData.description: Fill light, so the tier tints read in shadow too.

debugData.name: Physics tiers sun
debugData.description: Only its direction (position → targetPos) is kept: physicsTiers.ts adds a SUN_SHADOW_FIT component on scene enter, which fits its shadow to the main camera's view (the frustum here only applies until then).

scene01.description: Basic FIXED/DYNAMIC physics demo: a ground box, a bouncing box, a falling ball and cylinder, a TRIMESH-collider imported GLB, and a decorative rotating wireframe sphere.

skyShowcase.name: Sky showcase (day-night)
skyShowcase.description: The verification scene for the sky box plans (p113-p115): a day-night sky box with every layer, rows of metal and dielectric PBR spheres (roughness 0 to 1) and shadow casters. It also lists the space sky box (p114), for the nebula reflection check.

debugData.name: Sky showcase camera
debugData.description: Looks west over the sphere rows, toward the sunset (the scene's dayOfYear puts it just north of west).

debugData.name: Day-night (showcase)
debugData.description: The DAY_NIGHT preset (every p113 layer: atmosphere, sun and light, moon and light, stars and Milky Way, clouds and ground) on a 5-minute day.

debugData.name: Space
debugData.description: The SPACE preset (dense stars, two nebulae, no atmosphere) with a second, small blue sun. The primary sun's light frames its shadows on the origin, where the space demo's asteroids are.

space.name: Space demo (zero-g asteroids)
space.description: The SPACE sky box around a few procedural asteroids near the origin: zero world gravity, mutual (N-body) gravity, loose orbits and collisions. Debug env: the scene's own "Space demo" tab.

debugData.name: Space camera
debugData.description: Looks at the asteroids around the origin, toward the SPACE preset's first nebula; the sun lights them from the right.

debugData.name: Asteroid
debugData.description: Procedural object-space rock (no UVs): mottled colours, Worley pits, mineral speckles, bump. Every input is on colorNode, which also sets roughnessNode and normalNode; override `seed` per mesh for a different rock.

debugData.name: Space
debugData.description: The SPACE preset (dense stars, two nebulae, no atmosphere) with a second, small blue sun. The primary sun's light frames its shadows on the origin, where the space demo's asteroids are.

textureArrays.name: Texture arrays (p299)
textureArrays.description: p299's verification scene: runtime texture arrays (buildTextureArray) next to the textures they were built from. A 4-layer KTX2 array drawn by one quad and one material, the uncompressed PNG path, a one-member array of a texture asset, layer swaps after the first upload, `ktx create --layers` files, and texture array assets (*.textureArray.json) loaded by the scene loader. Files from devTools/assetPipeline/p299ArraySpike.ts.

debugData.name: p299 test array
debugData.description: p299 Phase 2: a build-time array of three layers of mixed sizes (a texture asset's 2048² source, a 256² and a 2048² file), resized to 512².

debugData.name: p299 one-layer test array
debugData.description: p299 Phase 2: a build-time array of one layer (a 256² file). `ktx create --layers 1` writes layerCount 1, which KTX2Loader loads as a plain CompressedTexture: loadTextureAsync wraps it.

thirdPersonGymScene.name: GYM (3rd person)
thirdPersonGymScene.description: Third-person obstacle-course/gym scene assembling every ported physics feature: ~15 imported GLBs, 6 moving platform variants, a player-controlled and a scripted dynamic character, and the physics stress-test spawner.

debugData.name: Third-person gym camera
debugData.description: Follow camera driven by createFollowObjectCameraRig (legacy gym's offset/lens settings), tracking the player-controlled character. This initial position/lookAt only matters for the first instant before the follow rig (APP_LOGIC) takes over each frame.

debugData.name: Third-person gym ambient fill
debugData.description: Low-intensity baseline fill so shadowed geometry isn't pure black — thirdPersonGymSun is the dominant light.

debugData.name: Third-person gym sun
debugData.description: Directional shadow-casting sun. scene_thirdPersonGym.ts moves it (and its target) with the player every frame, keeping this position - targetPos offset as the light direction, so the shadow frustum (sized for the play area around the player, not the whole scene, which would blur shadow resolution everywhere) follows the player instead of covering a fixed area around the origin.

topDownTestScene.name: Top-down test
topDownTestScene.description: Top-down character test scene (docs/plans/_DONE_p066_character-definitions-and-refactoring.md Phase 6): a WORLD_FIXED player (W = North = screen-up) on a large flat ground with a hills patch on the East side, scattered static obstacles and dynamic props, and a sun whose shadow is fitted to the camera view (SunShadowFit).

debugData.name: Top-down test camera
debugData.description: Follow camera driven by createFollowObjectCameraRig at a (0, 20, 8) offset: straight South of and above the player, so North (-Z) is screen-up. This initial position/lookAt only matters until the rig takes over.

debugData.name: Top-down test ambient fill
debugData.description: Low-intensity baseline fill so shadowed geometry isn't pure black — topDownTestSun is the dominant light.

debugData.name: Top-down test sun
debugData.description: Directional shadow-casting sun from the South-East, about 38° above the horizon. Only its direction (position → targetPos) is kept: scene_topDownTest.ts adds a SUN_SHADOW_FIT component on scene enter, which moves it with the camera view and owns its shadow frustum (the values here only apply until then).
